summary: Verified frontend fix for 'Mostra sezione Dati veicolo' product flag. On polizza VEIC-TST-1 (ramo Tutela Legale, prodotto Sicura Targa TEST with flag=true), the Veicolo tab now appears in both view mode and Modifica polizza dialog even though ramo is NOT RCAuto. Marca (edit-pol-marca) and Modello (edit-pol-modello) were filled and saved successfully - 'Polizza aggiornata' toast appeared and after reload the values FIAT / Panda are persisted and displayed. Targa field in edit dialog is a search-create component (data-testid='targa-search-input') requiring 'Crea Nuova Targa' click - existing behavior, not related to this fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Targa in edit dialog uses a search/create picker rather than a plain input; user must explicitly click 'Crea Nuova Targa AB123CD' to persist a new targa. Consider auto-creating on save or documenting this UX. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed polizza 8fef2d17-fa48-4301-bccb-0223917e1f58. Test set Marca=FIAT, Modello=Panda (persisted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix confirmed working. In PolizzaDetail.jsx isVeicoloPol (view) and isRCA (edit) correctly include prodotto_mostra_veicolo/_selProd.mostra_sezione_veicolo. Backend GET /polizze/{id} returns prodotto_mostra_veicolo=true for the seed polizza.
rca of the issue: Previously the Veicolo tab in polizza detail was gated only by ramo==='RCAuto'. Fix adds an OR condition on the product flag mostra_sezione_veicolo (resolved from library and exposed as prodotto_mostra_veicolo by GET /polizze/{id}).
